answer: Audits are recorded in wharf, queued in tide, and vertex publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 98 identities per epoch. A farm of 77 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 546 identities would post 4952 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
